newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels great for midnight beer - EU Commissioner.
newsitem.headline: Brussels great for midnight beer - EU Commissioner.

text.p: European Industry Commissioner Martin Bangemann loves living in Brussels -- he says you can sneak out in the middle of the night to buy a beer, something that would be unthinkable in his native Germany.

If you can't sleep and there is no beer in the fridge then "you can go down in the street and at some corner you find a shop where you can buy beer -- throughout the night," he told a Brussels conference on Tuesday.
Criticising German shop opening hours, Bangemann said nobody would even dream about such a situation in Germany.
"This is impossible for them, that somebody is working at night," he said. "If the Germans were able to do something reasonable at night you could understand that, but even there they lag behind."
